name: ab_mirror_wider_grids
$comment: Safety check for the mirror fix on the grids where it changes the graph but NOT the CP component count. Every dropped branch is a CHP GenericTransferBranch stub; the fix adds exactly the CHP count to each grid's ELECTRICITY component (simbench_lv 129->135, cp_heavy 129->138, mvlv 257->274) while the cross-sector component was already one piece.

The gas_dependent negative control was bit-identical but that grid had ZERO dropped branches, so it did not test this. These three did lose branches and must be checked for behavioural drift: the sector-scoped electricity reach feeds L2 dynamic-holon partitioning and DynamicConnectorRole.
Judge on: PWSF, served_by_sector, n_active - a benign result is 'no significant change'.
